name: Showman
source:
Gavis Bettel's Doppelganger

The Showman is a bossy and arrogant primadonna incapable of working with others for too long. The Showman's flamboyant theater monopolizes Skeleton Country's business world with an iron fist. In the past, he has attempted many times to take in proteges, stagehands, or even hangout buddies, but his self-centered nature and short temper have resulted in the loss of many skeleton afterlives. Eventually, this would become most of Skeleton Country's population.

[Edited from in-game profile]
